profiles.description: Guest on a hypervisor: no hardware-specific drivers or power tuning.
notes: CPU frequency and platform profile controls are usually emulated or absent in guests.
Hardware identifiers describe the virtual hardware, not the physical machine.

profiles.description: Laptop with two graphics vendors (integrated plus discrete).
notes: Keep the integrated adapter as the primary render device unless the user requests otherwise.
Proprietary discrete drivers are never installed automatically.

profiles.description: System whose graphics adapter is bound to the NVIDIA driver.
notes: The open kernel driver is used when it is available; the proprietary driver needs an explicit user decision.
Do not mix OpenQOS-provided and vendor-provided graphics libraries.

profiles.description: Machine with limited RAM; compressed swap and lighter defaults.
notes: Avoid desktop effects that need more than 2 GiB of free memory.

profiles.description: Single-vendor Intel laptop with integrated graphics.
notes: Intel laptops normally use the intel_pstate driver and SOF audio firmware.

profiles.description: Single-vendor AMD laptop with integrated graphics.
notes: amd-pstate with EPP is preferred over the legacy acpi-cpufreq driver.
Desktop power settings default to balanced; performance is a user choice.
AMD microcode updates are delivered through amd-ucode-firmware.

profiles.description: System whose only storage is a rotational disk.
notes: Do not schedule fstrim on rotational media.
Keep swap off the rotational disk when enough RAM exists.

profiles.description: Conservative baseline used when no specific profile matches.
notes: No specific hardware knowledge was applied.

intel-graphics.reason: Mesa userspace drivers and GuC/HuC/DMC firmware for Intel graphics.

amd-graphics.reason: Mesa userspace drivers and amdgpu firmware.

nvidia-firmware.reason: Firmware for the open Nouveau driver; the proprietary driver is not installed automatically.

amd-cpu-microcode.reason: CPU microcode updates for AMD processors.

intel-wifi.reason: Firmware required by the iwlwifi driver for Intel wireless adapters.

sof-audio.reason: Sound Open Firmware topology and firmware for Intel laptops.

power-management-laptop.reason: Exposes the ACPI platform profile through a supported D-Bus interface.

intel-thermal.reason: Userspace thermal management for Intel platforms.

zram.reason: Compressed RAM swap without changing the disk layout.
